purpose: Fixed text corpus for the P5 TTS backend comparison. Every category states what it is evidence for; nothing here asserts an expected result.

first_segment.purpose: Locate the first-segment character count where first-valid-PCM latency crosses the P95 <= 0.8 s objective. This curve is the deliverable the P6 segmenter consumes. The characters field is the real len() of the string, verified when the corpus was written.

numbers.purpose: Chinese number normalisation. Requires the rule FSTs (phone/date/number) to be wired correctly; a candidate that cannot read numbers correctly is unusable for a robot that reports coordinates, counts and status codes.
